performance_no_trace.note: Single runs, VERIFY/TRACE off; thermal state not recorded; cold-capture and warm-restore steps are separated
performance_no_trace.interpretation: Codec ON adds encode cost to the cold capture call (TTFT +22.3% on the 2079-token and +22.2% on the 4607-token capture); warm restore steps are within single-run variance to slightly slower. No TTFT/TPS improvement is claimed; the benefit is host FP16 prefix retention memory.

full_scope.method: test/htp/host/kv16_evidence_check.cpp ran on device in baseline and codec modes (NNTR_HTP_PREFIX_KV16=0/1, VERIFY=1 for codec): 4 fresh-prompt runs (warm-up + 2 seed captures + query continuation), device prefix capture enabled via enableDeviceKVManager(8,8); each capturing run dumped the resident DSP INT8 checkpoint via saveDeviceKVCache and hashed it after skipping the two run-unique framing fields (snapshot cookie at bytes [8,16) and the trailing FNV trailer that covers it); full logits were captured per run through a LogitsProcessor (first decode step), calibration observations hash the checkpoint-trace u32 bit words; raw dumps themselves differ between modes only in the cookie/trailer fields (kv16-dump-sha256.txt)
full_scope.events: 2 capture events per mode (run-1, run-2): token_ids, position, call-plan, calibration, logits, k/v/seed_kv/seed_scales/decode_state (all five = the byte-exact checkpoint dump)
full_scope.result: PASS (full): all checks PASS in both baseline and codec modes; codec.used confirmed non-zero compressed pages

repeat_performance.protocol: 3 interleaved rounds x (OFF,ON) with order alternation (off,on / on,off / off,on), 8s idle gate, thermal status recorded pre/post, no TRACE/VERIFY, RSS sampled every 2s from the host
repeat_performance.thermal_note: device thermal status escalated 0->1->2->3 across rounds (USB connected, back-to-back runs); interleaving balances but does not eliminate this

rss.interpretation: codec peak RSS is +27 MiB (encode scratch + compressed payload coexist with live cache during capture). The single-run MemAvailable minimum is ambient-noisy and is NOT attributable to the codec; per-handoff, pinned RPC slab views mean stored-byte savings do not map 1:1 to system memory. A dedicated long-residency memory experiment is still required.

repeat_performance.conclusion: Warm restore TPOT/TTFT are equal within noise; the codec costs +24~27% TTFT on cold capture and ~4s extra load/teardown. The benefit remains host FP16 prefix retention bytes (109.3 MB per full snapshot set), with no TTFT/TPS improvement.

device_config_note: The pack's pre-existing nntr_config.json (12387 bytes, 2026-11-09) was overwritten by the checkpoint config before a backup copy could be taken; it was restored from nntr_config.gemma4_pf2k.json (12387 bytes, byte-size match) after the runs. The exact original content is not byte-proven; the pf2k/f2k variants remain in the pack directory and nntr_config.kv16_checkpoint.json preserves the validation config.
